opening.prompt: A cinematic close-up from an experimental punk comic-book animated film, widescreen. A single original character with a ROUND WHITE FACE and a short upright RAINBOW MOHAWK, seen from a very slight three-quarter angle, looking right. Their head and all of their hair fit fully inside the image, surrounded by generous space; the head occupies half the picture height. The face is chalk white with enormous expressive ink-black eyes, sharply drawn eyebrows, a tiny nose and a mischievous determined expression. A narrow crest of stiff triangular hair spikes runs over the center of the head: crimson, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, violet. Clean shaved white sides. Strong sculpted three-dimensional face and a small visible white neck, with graphic dark violet halftone-dot shadows across the left cheek, cyan offset rim light and gritty brush-hatched outlines. This is a detailed mixed-media film frame: luminous screen-printed layers, thick rough black ink, Ben-Day dot shading, color misregistration and visible paper grain over dimensional forms. Behind the character: an abstract magenta industrial tunnel with acid-yellow geometric shards, large cyan brush marks and deep violet dimensional recesses; its busy detail is pushed toward the edges to keep the white head and rainbow silhouette clear. Off-center composition, dramatic perspective, high contrast, anarchic printmaking texture and energetic diagonals. No writing, no letters, no logos. Only one head and one face.
